before.problem: R3 one-center cost gate cannot represent ambiguity between different service locations; hard one-step certification has already failed.
before.plan: Compare original single-center cost; fixed 9-point A2 planning quadrature averaged cost; same quadrature with colored decision-region EC2 remaining edge mass and Noisy-OR progress. Same arrival points/real geometry/budget.

before.graph: Actions at each hypothesis plus pair midpoints where pair distance<=40. Unique optical coverage masks cover H. Greedy color disjoint regions. Each color induces selected decision classes + remaining membership-pattern classes. EC2 ratio=(k^2-sum(class_survivor_count^2))/(n^2-sum(class_count^2)), with original unnormalized weights. F=1-product ratios.
before.model_boundary: Finite hypotheses are state-local planning proposals, not true known prior; bounded-error geometric consistency sets for hypothetical outcomes can overlap. Thus expected F is a heuristic surrogate, not exact deterministic DRD expected value. No approximation theorem transfers. Gate uses F*(8+(r-20)+/5+6*[r>100])-6 seconds proxy.
before.degenerate: Fewer than2 valid positions fall back to parent; zero-edge graph/unmodeled empty outcome fall back to same multi-cost.
